protocol.selection: top 20 by existing fitness, ties lower ID, parent IDs sorted, five mutated offspring each
protocol.matched_randomness: same founders and round-specific bodies; common mutation masks, Gaussian draws, and slot shuffles, with recorded draw hashes
protocol.generalist: one habitat per scored round, equal exposure in every three-round block; six curriculum permutations counterbalanced by seed phase; not simultaneous joint-fitness optimization
protocol.freeze: reproduce after every scored round, including the last; freeze all 100 unscored offspring at generation rounds+1
protocol.primary_family: nine fitness contrasts: each home specialist minus generalist and each of the other two specialists in that same test habitat; two-sided paired exact sign tests with Holm over nine
protocol.intervals: pointwise approximate 95% paired percentile bootstrap, 20000 resamples
protocol.decision: higher/lower requires Holm p<0.05 and a mean-difference interval excluding zero in the same direction; reciprocal specialization requires both specialists significantly winning in their own habitat
protocol.analysis_unit: one matched source seed group; repeats averaged within habitat before inference
protocol.secondary: meals, survival to 60s, and generalist-minus-specialist average fitness across equally weighted habitats descriptive, without confirmatory p-values
protocol.limitations: food supply changes absolute task difficulty; compare regimes within the same column, not raw home-vs-away scores. Curriculum and final-context effects remain possible despite order counterbalancing. One architecture, budget, speed, and environment family.
